_note: Frame selection computed by scripts/refresh_video_cache.py. Deterministic arithmetic over the video - sharpness and perceptual hashing, no model, no claims.
statement: 5 frame(s) were taken from 14 seconds of video and analysed as photographs. 4 were too blurred to read - a blurred frame is worse than no frame, because it is the input most likely to turn a shadow into a dent. 4 showed the same view as a frame already chosen.
